title: Disputes
description: Review and resolve disputes between customers and providers.

help.title: About Disputes
help.overview: A dispute is a disagreement about a marketplace order that an administrator decides. While it is open, the order's money is frozen: no delivery acceptance, milestone release, auto-acceptance, or cancellation. The decision says who gets what is still held.

sections.title: Raising a dispute
items: Either party of the order can raise one, on an order that is not completed or cancelled. One dispute per order.
The caller is the initiator; the other party is notified.
Customers can also raise one from their storefront account.

sections.title: Statuses and decisions
sections.body: Only an administrator decides, and a resolution note is required.
items: Open: raised and waiting. Start review moves it to under review.
Resolve (from open or under review) decides for the provider: a waiting delivery is accepted, the order completes, and the rest of the escrow is released to the provider.
Close (from open or under review) decides for the customer: the order is cancelled and the rest of the escrow is refunded.
Both parties are notified of the outcome.

sections.title: Deleting
items: Only an administrator can delete a dispute, because an open one blocks the payout. A deleted dispute cannot be acted on until restored.
